Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with the Weber E210 Grill that we purchased.  I would like to point out couple of issues I have noticed. (1) I am eighty years old and getting a full tank up on the monitoring hook is a bit of a challenge.  I placed a 2x4 under the grill set the tank on it before trying to lift it and it did make it easier. (2) The metering mechanism for the tank is not working; however, I had Low's assemble the grill and I haven't had time to troubleshoot the metering mechanism.  The spacing of the grills are a little wide but now that I am aware it is not a issue.  Overall I am extremely happy with the grill!!
Results.Title: E-210 Very Happy

Results.ReviewText: Wanted a Weber grill for a long time, always found the price a bit high. Brought an Amazon grill and it rusted away in less than two years. Got a coupon from Lowe’s for 10% off, plus free assembly and delivery. We use the Weber three to four days a week. We love it.
Results.Title: Love the Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Love this new grill!  Heats up quickly and feels very built.  My first Weber and I’m very impressed!
Results.Title: First Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I am a big fan or the original Weber kettle barbeque but sometimes I do not have the time to get the briquettes going and I wished I had a gas grill so I went with the Weber Spirit E-210. I took one to the family cabin and I was so happy with it, I bought one for home as well.  It is built well and despite having two burner settings there is plenty of grilling space.  What I like about the 2 burner is that the side stainless steel shelves fold down, taking up less space, yet they are extremely sturdy when they are expanded.  I couldn't be happier with this purchase.  I would highly recommend it to anyone wanting a gas grill.

Results.ReviewText:
We purchased the grill, in a box, in mid August 2024. The box was quite large and quite heavy and all of the parts were well packed in the box. Most of the packing material was recyclable, but there was a fair amount of styrofoam and plastic bags included in the materials which had to be sent to a landfill for disposal. The directions were all pictorial which were slightly difficult to follow since there was no or very little text for clarification. We had to disassemble and reassemble at least two or three times due to ambiguities in the instructions. But in the end, the grill was quite sturdy and useable.
The grill heats up remarkable fast to a very high temperature. We have used it only a handful of times and only for grilling so far. It works quite well.
The real test will be over time and an assessment of how long the parts remain in working order.

Results.ReviewText: We purchased our spirit grill 2 years ago. Were kept it covered with a Weber grill cover.  I keep the grill spotless and within months of cooking on it, the thermometer stopped working, ok I can live with that. Then I realized that the inside of the grill lid is chipping paint , god knows for many days before I saw. I’ve been feeding my family paint chips.  I thought if we bought a better quality grill it would last us a few years but honestly our cheap one from lowes lasted our family almost a decade.

Results.ReviewText: Wish it was made of stainless steel instead of just polished steel.  Otherwise it is GREAT!  Cooks evenly, fast and, is easily cleaned.
Results.Title: Works GREAT! Stainless steel?

Results.ReviewText: Love my new grill! It's easy to use, compact, and big enough to cook several items at a time. (My first cookout included chicken thighs, hamburgers, and sausages.) I have to keep it on my covered porch for now as I haven't set up properly on the grass outside the porch. It doesn't take up too much room with my furniture. It came assembled, so I only needed someone to get the gas tank secured underneath. I like this feature because it'll show how much gas is left in the tank. No surprises! The side shelves have ample space to put plates, bowls, etc. And the integrated hooks on both ends hold my utensils and glove. I bought a cover separately. It's sleek and clean look protects as well.
Results.Title: Has it all!

Results.ReviewText: There may be others like me out there. I previously had the Weber Genesis E-330. It still worked great from my 2011 purchase. But I'm a widower now. And it was taking up a lot of space - and is a little larger for cooking for 1. I resisted a smaller grill like the Spirit E-210 because I was concerned it wouldn't put out the same heat. Not to worry if you have the same concern. This a great choice for 1 or 2 people and those with limited space. I cooks like it's larger cousins.

Cooking is okay, no better than any other grill (even less expensive ones) I have purchased. The quality of the materials, especially the fold-down sides, is better than the less expensive grills. Not sure it is worth the extra money; only time will tell.
Results.Title: Not Sure it is Worth Extra Money

Results.ReviewText:
I’ve had many Weber kettles over the 20 to 30 years. The oldest kettle is a little worst for wear now but still in use.  I’ve replaced handles, legs, wheels, grill grates and have added many accessories over the years. I’ve also had a few gas grills in this time but none were Webers.  On day I had the opportunity to pick up a Spirit E-210 from a friend. The grill was a 2013 model and well used. I got it home, I cleaned the ol girl up and to my surprise it was all original. It was missing a few things and the flavorizer bars had seen better days. I went to amazon to get the new parts, which included grease pan, flavorizer bars, new knobs, Igniter kit, (the old one still had the original battery and was working, but was leaking black tar like goop), and the warming rack. The only other thing that was needed was the propane manifold. This was the only part I could not find on amazon. I went to Weber’s website and found the diagram for this model and got the part numbers for everything I needed to insure proper fit on everything before ordering from Amazon. I located the number to customer service and thought what the heck, I’ll case and see if someone will answer.  Now to be honest I wasn’t expecting anyone to answer except maybe a computer, being that it was Sunday evening. SUNDAY EVENING PEOPLE!! I was excited when an actual person, a human a real live human answered the call. Now this guy, I wish I could remember his name, asked a few questions, found the correct part that I was looking for, collected some information and got the grill registered in my name. Within a few days all the new parts arrived, I I got everything installed. The grill is working great and we love it. This ol girl will be around for many more years.  Disclaimer, I truly believe that one of the main factors behind the grill being in such great overall condition, was the Weber cover that was put on after each cook. I’m still using the original cover as it is in remarkable shape considering it’s age. Did I say it was SUNDAY and someone answered the phone?!?
Big shoutout to the Weber family for building such great products and their commitment to customer service.
Results.Title: 5⭐️ Product and Service

If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.
